tasks.description: Stand and balance in place for about 2 seconds, keeping the torso upright and at standing height. Do not fall.
Stand and hold your position without drifting sideways or falling.
From standing, squat down about 0.12 m by bending hips and knees, then stand back up. Stay balanced.
From standing, squat down about 0.20 m (deeper bend), then return to standing without toppling.
Stand and balance steadily for a longer hold, torso upright and at full standing height the whole time.
